# RouteRiff\n\nRouteRiff is a browser-first visual itinerary tool. It turns a sequence of travel stops into a map, estimates directional distance and travel load, flags obvious routing problems, animates the journey, and creates a shareable/remixable URL.\n\n## Primary capability\n- Paste cities or stops separated by lines, commas or arrows.\n- Visualize the route on OpenStreetMap.\n- Get a simple route-sanity score and travel-load estimate.\n- Play the route as an animation.\n- Share or remix the trip.\n- Open independent booking partners through disclosed affiliate links.\n\n## Important limitations\nDistance, travel-time and transport-mode outputs are rough planning estimates, not live schedule, visa, safety, weather or booking advice. Confirm critical information with official sources and booking providers.\n\nCanonical product URL: https://routeriff.vercel.app/\n

## Primary positioning
RouteRiff is a second-pass AI itinerary sanity checker, not a general travel chatbot or OTA. A traveler brings an itinerary from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, a blog, spreadsheet or friend. RouteRiff visualizes the geographic route, estimates rough travel load, flags potential backtracking and long jumps, supports manual reordering and a simple optimizer, and creates a correction prompt that can be sent back to any AI.

## Commercial disclosure
Some optional booking exits are affiliate links. Affiliate economics do not change the route score or route-order logic.

- https://routeriff.vercel.app/japan-itinerary-checker/
- https://routeriff.vercel.app/china-itinerary-checker/

- https://routeriff.vercel.app/examples/ai-itinerary-fails/

## Input options
- Plain-text lists, arrows, bullets and common AI itinerary lines.
- Optional trip-day count for pacing context.
- Local .txt, .md and common .csv itinerary imports; these files are read in the browser and are not uploaded by the importer.
- Full Google Maps directions URLs and Apple Maps start/destination links.
- Google Maps short links are expanded only through a restricted Google-host redirect resolver.

## Current audit behaviors
- Rough straight-line route distance and travel-load heuristic.
- Very long-leg warnings.
- Potential backtracking and largest-detour-stop detection.
- Trip-day pacing warnings.
- Cross-country hop warning when the route repeatedly changes country.
- Manual reorder/remove, simple middle-stop optimizer and before/after comparison.
- Model-agnostic cleanup prompt and correction prompt.
- Shareable/remixable route URL and social share card.
- Booking options are gated behind review when the route verdict still needs attention.

- https://routeriff.vercel.app/is-my-itinerary-too-rushed/
